stem:
Trisha burns a strip of magnesium in air and dissolves the white product in water; the solution turns red litmus blue. She also burns sulfur in air and dissolves that product in water; the solution turns blue litmus red.

Which two claims correctly decide whether each product is basic or acidic?

options.text: The magnesium product in water is basic, because red litmus turns blue.
The magnesium product in water is acidic, because burning in air always makes an acid.
The sulfur product in water is acidic, because blue litmus turns red.
Both products are basic, because any substance that burns in air forms a base.

teacher.key_rationale: Litmus shows the magnesium product is basic and the sulfur product is acidic. Burning in air does not force one acid-base outcome for every product.
